events-smoke-no-legacy-launch.retires: The clause that the tick lane launch is never called patches the legacy spawn function the removal deletes; the removal drops that patch and keeps the no worker spawn and open task assertions.

hive-stop-recovery-handoff.gap: The events hub admission claim carries no handoff document text, so a successor primed with a recovery handoff exists only on the legacy spawn; ported by the handoff text follow up.

swarm-agent-record-launch-decision-at-sp.retires: The detached launch job and successor retry clauses retire with the launch job module.

swarm-claim-refunds-legacy.retires: Each test counts tick respawns in the fake runtime's spawned list, which only the legacy spawn step fills; t-legacy-events-only deletes them with that step. The quota handoff and preemption refunds stay covered on the events path by tests/hub/test_lifecycle.py::test_exit_refunds_a_started_life_for_a_park_a_quota_handoff_or_an_operator_preemption, and the fourth claim block by tests/hub/test_admission.py::test_events_admission_blocks_spent_claim_lives_before_creating_an_execution. The swarm retirement refunds for an account mismatch, idling or a stop are covered on the events path by tests/swarm/test_events_claim_refunds.py::test_a_swarm_retirement_refunds_the_claim_life_of_an_events_launched_agent and tests/swarm/test_events_claim_refunds.py::test_a_swarm_stop_refunds_the_claim_life_of_an_events_launched_agent, and the parked retirement after release by tests/swarm/test_events_claim_refunds.py::test_an_events_parked_retirement_refunds_nothing_once_its_claim_was_released.

swarm-focus.gap: The dispatcher band over ledger rank and the demotion of a task whose launch failed order only the legacy spawn; the hub readiness offers hold no dispatcher claim key or demotion list, filed as a follow up.

swarm-launch-check.retires: The tick judged launch checks of workers the legacy spawn started, with their one relaunch, retire with it.
swarm-launch-check.gap: Workers the hub admits get no launch check and no single relaunch; ported by the ledger follow up on hub admitted worker launch checks, raised by task t-leo-spawn-tick.

swarm-master-skips-host-hold.retires: The held engineer clause is the legacy spawn host room hold.

swarm-reclaim.gap: The events hub admission claim never resolves a continuation, so a reclaimed task continues from its recorded branch only on the legacy spawn; ported by the continuation resolve follow up.

swarm-spawn-order-once-per-pass.retires: The spawn pass claim order and its replayed ledger timing clauses retire with the legacy spawn pass.

swarm-tick-launch-budget.retires: The launch budget bounds the legacy spawn pass; its forgiveness of a failed launch and its pool pricing go with it.
swarm-tick-launch-budget.gap: The urgent head and failed task ordering inside a band orders only the legacy spawn, recorded under swarm-focus.

swarm-tick-launch-cluster.retires: The behaviour is the legacy launch cluster the spawn step drives.

swarm-tick-legacy-claim-holds-and-overla.retires: The holds and the overlap payload are read off the legacy spawn's claims; under events hub readiness holds unready tasks and admission carries the overlaps (tests/hub/test_admission.py::test_an_admitted_task_carries_its_territory_overlaps_and_its_group).

swarm-tick-legacy-lane-fill.retires: The lane caps, spawn order, failed launch slots and per pass launch budget are the legacy spawn pass itself; under events hub readiness offers each task and a hive admits it against its own max agents (tests/hub/test_admission.py), so these retire with the spawn step.

swarm-tick-legacy-master-start-holds-wor.retires: Only the clause that the legacy spawn launched no worker reaches the spawn; the removal drops that clause and keeps the master start, control command and state assertions.

swarm-tick-legacy-respawn.retires: The same pass respawn after a reclaim is the legacy spawn; under events the tick reopens the task (swarm-tick-events-orphans) and hub admission seats the successor with its pull request state, handoff, branch and seat (tests/hub/test_admission.py).

swarm-tick-launch-outcomes-legacy.retires: Reopening a failed launch, steering the pass's other launches, the pass capacity report and the drained note are legacy spawn pass outputs; under events a failed launch keeps its admission for redelivery steered off its own harness, covered by the hub admission steering tests and swarm-events-claim-cap.

swarm-tick-launch-pool-legacy.retires: The launch pool, its room and its spawn budget exist only in the legacy spawn pass; events hives launch one admitted task at a time against the hive max agents.

swarm-tick-panic-holds-spawn.retires: The spawn due clause retires with the spawn due marker; the dispatch seat clause stays covered.

swarm-tick-spawn.retires: The behaviour is the legacy tick spawn step itself.

tick-runtime-port-fence.retires: The ack pass clauses retire with the legacy launch acknowledgement collection.

tick-spawn-metrics-processes.retires: The process table rescan clause belongs to the legacy spawn launch.
